blocks.text: O'zbekchadagi «**davomida**», «**paytida**», «**... -ayotganda**» ingliz tilida uch xil so'z bilan beriladi va ular turli savollarga javob beradi. **during** — «qachon?» (qaysi davr ichida): **during** the film. **for** — «qancha vaqt?» (davomiylik): **for** two hours. **while** — «qachon?», lekin undan keyin to'liq gap keladi: **while** I was watching the film. Asoslar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 104–105-darslar; for va since — → 12-dars), bu yerda ularning chegaralari va qiyin holatlarini ko'ramiz.

**during** dan keyin **nomlangan davr** keladi: the summer, the meeting, my stay, the war. Bu voqea o'sha davr ichida (bir lahzada yoki butun davr bo'yi) bo'lganini bildiradi. **for** dan keyin esa **muddat uzunligi** keladi: five minutes, two weeks, ages. Shuning uchun «during three days» noto'g'ri — uch kun nomlangan davr emas, muddat. Ikkalasi bitta gapda ham keladi: I was ill **for** a week **during** the holidays.

items.text: We stayed in Khiva **for** three nights **during** our trip.
Somebody tried to open our car **during** the night.
I've been standing in this queue **for** forty minutes!
items.translation: Bu navbatda qirq daqiqa**dan beri** turibman!

blocks.text: **during** va **while** ma'nosi bir xil — «... paytida» — farq faqat grammatikada: **during** — predlog (+ ot), **while** — bog'lovchi (+ ega + fe'l). O'tmish haqida while dan keyin ko'pincha **Past Continuous** keladi, chunki u fon harakatni bildiradi (→ 6-dars): during the meeting = **while** we **were having** the meeting. as ham shunday ma'noda kelishi mumkin (→ 116-dars).

items.text: The baby slept peacefully **during** the journey.
The baby slept peacefully **while** we were driving to Samarkand.

blocks.text: Kelajak haqida gapirganda while dan keyin ham **will** qo'yilmaydi — Present ishlatiladi, xuddi when, if, as soon as dagidek (→ 25-dars): I'll call you **while** I**'m** in London. Ikkala qismning egasi bir xil bo'lsa, while dan keyin ega va yordamchi fe'lni tushirib, **-ing** qoldirish mumkin (→ 68-dars): **while waiting**, **while driving**. during dan keyin esa fe'l ishlatilmaydi — faqat ot.

items.text: I'll look after your cat **while** you're away.
Jasur hurt his knee **while** playing tennis.

blocks.text: **while** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — qarama-qarshilik («... bo'lsa, ... esa», = whereas): **While** Tom loves football, his brother prefers chess. Turg'un ibora: **for a while** — «bir muddat», «biroz vaqt»: Can you wait **for a while**?

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «**during** three days» → **for** three days (muddat — for). 2) «**during** I was sleeping» → **while** I was sleeping; «**while** the lesson» → **during** the lesson. 3) «while I **will be** in London» → while I**'m** in London. 4) «**for** all day», «**during** all the summer» → **all day**, **all summer** yoki **throughout** the summer. 5) «**during** waiting» → **while** waiting.

O'zingizga savol bering: «**Qancha vaqt?**» — **for**. «**Qachon?**» va keyin ot (the film, my holiday) — **during**. «**Qachon?**» va keyin ega + fe'l (I was, we're) — **while**. O'zbekchadagi «davomida» so'ziga ishonmang: u for ga ham, during ga ham to'g'ri keladi.

examples.title: **During** + noun: when something happens
examples.description: during + ot — «... paytida», «... davomida»: voqea qaysi davr ichida bo'lgani. Savol: qachon?

sentences.text: Please keep your phones switched off **during** the performance.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, tomosha **davomida** telefonlaringizni o'chirib qo'ying.

sentences.text: Bekzod fell asleep **during** the lecture on tax law.
sentences.translation: Soliq huquqi bo'yicha ma'ruza **paytida** Bekzod uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: **During** our stay in Edinburgh, it rained almost every afternoon.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda **bo'lgan paytimizda** deyarli har kuni tushdan keyin yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: Several trees in our street were blown down **during** the night.
sentences.translation: **Tunda** shamol ko'chamizdagi bir nechta daraxtni qulatib ketdi.

sentences.text: Many cafés in Tashkent change their opening hours **during** Ramadan.
sentences.translation: Ramazon **oyida** Toshkentdagi ko'p kafelar ish vaqtini o'zgartiradi.

sentences.text: I met my future wife **during** my first year at university.
sentences.translation: Universitetning birinchi **kursida** bo'lajak rafiqam bilan tanishdim.

sentences.text: The museum was closed **during** the renovation, so we couldn't visit it.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir **davomida** muzey yopiq edi, shuning uchun unga kira olmadik.

sentences.text: Did anything interesting happen at work **during** my absence?
sentences.translation: Men **yo'q paytimda** ishda biror qiziq narsa bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: **During** the 2008 crisis, thousands of people lost their jobs.
sentences.translation: 2008-yilgi inqiroz **paytida** minglab odamlar ishidan ayrildi.

sentences.text: Sarah sometimes wakes up **during** the night and can't get back to sleep.
sentences.translation: Sara ba'zan **tunda** uyg'onib ketadi va qayta uxlay olmaydi.

examples.title: **For** + a period: how long
examples.description: for + muddat — «... davomida», «... -dan beri», «... -ga»: qancha vaqt? for two hours, for a week, for ages.

sentences.text: We waited at the border **for** almost four hours.
sentences.translation: Chegarada deyarli to'rt soat **kutdik**.

sentences.text: Jasur has been learning Japanese **for** three years.
sentences.translation: Jasur uch yil**dan beri** yapon tilini o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: Can I borrow your charger **for** a few minutes?
sentences.translation: Quvvatlagichingni bir necha daqiqa**ga** olib tursam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: The road to Chimgan will be closed **for** two weeks because of repairs.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir tufayli Chimyonga boradigan yo'l ikki hafta**ga** yopiladi.

sentences.text: Emma lived in Samarkand **for** a year before moving back to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Emma Oksfordga qaytishdan oldin Samarqandda **bir yil** yashadi.

sentences.text: I haven't seen Aziz **for** ages — is he still working abroad?
sentences.translation: Azizni ancha**dan beri** ko'rmadim — hali ham chet elda ishlayaptimi?

sentences.text: **For** the first few days, the new job was absolutely exhausting.
sentences.translation: Dastlabki bir necha kun **davomida** yangi ish meni juda charchatdi.

sentences.text: They stayed in the hotel **for** just one night, as the prices were too high.
sentences.translation: Narxlar juda baland bo'lgani uchun ular mehmonxonada faqat **bir kecha** qolishdi.

sentences.text: How long are you staying in London? — Just **for** the weekend.
sentences.translation: Londonda qancha vaqt qolasiz? — Faqat dam olish kunlari**ga**.

sentences.text: The baby cried **for** most of the flight, so nobody got any sleep.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq parvozning ko'p qismi **davomida** yig'ladi, shuning uchun hech kim uxlay olmadi.

examples.title: **During** or **for**? Sometimes both
examples.description: during — qaysi davrda (qachon?), for — qancha vaqt. Bitta gapda ikkalasi ham: for two weeks during the summer.

sentences.text: I was in hospital **for** five days **during** the winter.
sentences.translation: **Qishda** besh **kun** kasalxonada yotdim.

sentences.text: It snowed **for** three days **during** our holiday in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Tog'dagi ta'tilimiz **paytida** uch kun **davomida** qor yog'di.

sentences.text: Madina worked as a waitress **for** two months **during** the summer holidays.
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'til **paytida** Madina **ikki oy** ofitsiantka bo'lib ishladi.

sentences.text: **During** the meeting, the manager spoke **for** forty minutes without a break.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish **paytida** rahbar qirq daqiqa **davomida** to'xtovsiz gapirdi.

sentences.text: The power went off **for** an hour **during** the football match.
sentences.translation: Futbol o'yini **paytida** elektr bir soat**ga** o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: We didn't hear anything **during** the night — we slept **for** ten hours!
sentences.translation: **Tunda** hech narsa eshitmadik — o'n soat **davomida** uxladik!

sentences.text: Nilufar studied in Germany **for** a semester **during** her master's degree.
sentences.translation: Magistratura **davomida** Nilufar **bir semestr** Germaniyada o'qidi.

sentences.text: Have you ever stayed awake **for** a whole night before an exam?
sentences.translation: Hech qachon imtihon oldidan butun tun **davomida** uxlamay chiqqanmisan?

sentences.text: **During** the flight, I watched films **for** about five hours.
sentences.translation: Parvoz **paytida** besh soat**cha** film ko'rdim.

sentences.text: The bridge will be closed to traffic **for** a month **during** the repairs.
sentences.translation: Ta'mir **davomida** ko'prik bir oy**ga** transport uchun yopiladi.

examples.title: **While** + clause: while I was waiting
examples.description: while + ega + fe'l — «... -ayotganda», «... paytida». O'tmishda ko'pincha Past Continuous bilan.

sentences.text: Somebody stole my wallet **while** I was waiting for the bus.
sentences.translation: Avtobus **kutayotganimda** kimdir hamyonimni o'g'irlab ketdi.

sentences.text: **While** Kate was living in London, she worked for a bank.
sentences.translation: Keyt Londonda **yashagan paytida** bankda ishlagan.

sentences.text: Could you water the plants **while** we're on holiday?
sentences.translation: Biz ta'tilda **bo'lgan paytimizda** gullarga suv quyib tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: The phone rang twice **while** I was having a shower.
sentences.translation: Dush **qabul qilayotganimda** telefon ikki marta jiringladi.

sentences.text: **While** the children were playing in the garden, the adults made plov.
sentences.translation: Bolalar bog'da **o'ynayotganda**, kattalar palov damlashdi.

sentences.text: I listened to a podcast about history **while** I was cooking dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat **tayyorlayotganimda** tarix haqidagi podkastni tingladim.

sentences.text: Oliver broke his leg **while** he was skiing in the Alps.
sentences.translation: Alp tog'larida chang'i **uchayotganda** Oliver oyog'ini sindirib oldi.

sentences.text: Did anybody call the office **while** I was out?
sentences.translation: Men **yo'q paytimda** ofisga kimdir qo'ng'iroq qildimi?

sentences.text: Aziz learned a lot about the business **while** he was working for his uncle.
sentences.translation: Amakisining qo'lida **ishlagan paytida** Aziz bu biznes haqida ko'p narsa o'rgandi.

sentences.text: **While** we were driving through Fergana, our car broke down twice.
sentences.translation: Farg'ona bo'ylab **ketayotganimizda** mashinamiz ikki marta buzildi.

examples.title: **During** or **while**?
examples.description: Ma'no bir xil — «... paytida». during + ot (during the exam), while + ega + fe'l (while the exam is going on).

sentences.text: Jasur's phone rang **during** the exam, and the teacher took it away.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **paytida** Jasurning telefoni jiringladi va o'qituvchi uni olib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Nobody is allowed to talk **while** the exam is going on.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **ketayotgan paytda** hech kimga gapirishga ruxsat yo'q.

sentences.text: **During** the flight to London, I read an entire novel.
sentences.translation: Londonga parvoz **paytida** butun boshli romanni o'qib chiqdim.

sentences.text: I usually sleep **while** I'm flying, but this time I couldn't.
sentences.translation: Odatda **uchayotganimda** uxlayman, lekin bu safar uxlay olmadim.

sentences.text: Lots of people catch colds **during** the winter months.
sentences.translation: Qish oylari **davomida** ko'p odamlar shamollaydi.

sentences.text: Remember to drink plenty of water **while** you're travelling in the desert.
sentences.translation: Cho'lda **sayohat qilayotganingizda** ko'p suv ichishni unutmang.

sentences.text: We made friends with a Scottish couple **during** our trip to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxoroga **sayohatimiz paytida** bir shotlandiyalik er-xotin bilan do'stlashdik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza got to know people from all over the world **while** she was studying abroad.
sentences.translation: Chet elda **o'qiyotgan paytida** Dilnoza dunyoning turli burchaklaridan kelgan odamlar bilan tanishdi.

sentences.text: Don't use your laptop **during** take-off and landing.
sentences.translation: Uchish va qo'nish **paytida** noutbukdan foydalanmang.

sentences.text: The lights went off **while** the director was giving his speech.
sentences.translation: Direktor nutq **so'zlayotganda** chiroqlar o'chib qoldi.

examples.title: **While** + present (future) and **while** + -ing
examples.description: Kelajak haqida ham while dan keyin Present (will emas). Ega bir xil bo'lsa — while + -ing: while waiting, while driving.

sentences.text: I'll do the shopping **while** you're at the dentist.
sentences.translation: Sen stomatologda **bo'lgan paytingda** xarid qilib kelaman.

sentences.text: **While** I'm in Manchester next week, I hope to visit my old university.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta Manchesterda **bo'lgan paytimda** eski universitetimga borib kelmoqchiman.

sentences.text: Please don't disturb Grandma **while** she's resting after lunch.
sentences.translation: Buvim tushlikdan keyin **dam olayotganda** uni bezovta qilmang.

sentences.text: Be careful **while** crossing the road near the school.
sentences.translation: Maktab yaqinida yo'ldan **o'tayotganda** ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: Bekzod injured his back **while** lifting a heavy box.
sentences.translation: Og'ir qutini **ko'tarayotganda** Bekzod belini shikastlab oldi.

sentences.text: **While** waiting for the results, Madina tried to stay calm.
sentences.translation: Natijalarni **kutayotganda** Madina xotirjam bo'lishga harakat qildi.

sentences.text: Some people like listening to music **while** studying, but I need silence.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi odamlar **o'qiyotganda** musiqa tinglashni yoqtiradi, menga esa jimlik kerak.

sentences.text: We'll keep your luggage at reception **while** you're exploring the city.
sentences.translation: Siz shaharni **aylanayotganingizda** yukingizni qabulxonada saqlab turamiz.

sentences.text: Never use your phone **while** driving — it's both illegal and dangerous.
sentences.translation: Mashina **haydayotganda** hech qachon telefondan foydalanmang — bu ham noqonuniy, ham xavfli.

sentences.text: **While** you're waiting, would you like a cup of tea?
sentences.translation: **Kutib turganingizda** bir piyola choy ichasizmi?

examples.title: Dialogue: back from Scotland
examples.description: Ikki do'st sayohat haqida gaplashadi: during, for va while bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Welcome back! Did it rain all the time **during** your trip to Scotland?
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsan! Shotlandiyaga safaring **davomida** doim yomg'ir yog'dimi?

sentences.text: — Not at all! It only rained **for** a couple of days.
sentences.translation: — Umuman yo'q! Faqat ikki kun**cha** yomg'ir yog'di.

sentences.text: — And what did you do **while** you were in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: — Edinburgda **bo'lgan paytingda** nima qilding?

sentences.text: — We walked around the old town **for** hours and visited the castle.
sentences.translation: — Eski shahar bo'ylab **soatlab** sayr qildik va qal'ani ko'rdik.

sentences.text: — Did anything go wrong **during** the trip?
sentences.translation: — Safar **paytida** biror narsa noto'g'ri ketdimi?

sentences.text: — Well, someone took my scarf **while** I was having lunch in a café.
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, kafeda **tushlik qilayotganimda** kimdir sharfimni olib ketdi.

sentences.text: — Oh no! And did you stay in the Highlands **for** long?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Tog'li hududlarda **uzoq** qoldingmi?

sentences.text: — Only **for** three nights, but **during** that time we saw some amazing places.
sentences.translation: — Faqat uch **kecha**, lekin o'sha vaqt **davomida** ajoyib joylarni ko'rdik.

sentences.text: — I'd love to go there **while** the weather is still warm.
sentences.translation: — Havo hali iliq **ekanida** u yerga borishni juda istardim.

sentences.text: — Then book soon — hotels fill up quickly **during** the summer.
sentences.translation: — Unda tezroq bron qil — yoz **paytida** mehmonxonalar tez to'lib qoladi.

examples.title: Mixed: work, health and travel
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: during, for, while (vaqt va qarama-qarshilik ma'nosida) murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: **During** the pandemic, millions of people worked from home **for** months.
sentences.translation: Pandemiya **paytida** millionlab odamlar oylar **davomida** uydan ishladi.

sentences.text: **While** some experts welcome the new law, others say it goes too far.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi mutaxassislar yangi qonunni **olqishlayotgan bo'lsa**, boshqalar uni haddan tashqari qattiq deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: The shop will be closed **for** five days **during** the New Year holidays.
sentences.translation: Yangi yil bayramlari **paytida** do'kon besh kun**ga** yopiladi.

sentences.text: Kate checks her emails **while** she's having breakfast, which annoys her husband.
sentences.translation: Keyt nonushta **qilayotganda** elektron pochtasini tekshiradi, bu esa erining jig'iga tegadi.

sentences.text: Our flight was delayed **for** six hours, and **during** that time the airline gave us nothing.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz olti soat**ga** kechikdi va o'sha vaqt **davomida** aviakompaniya bizga hech narsa bermadi.

sentences.text: Doctors recommend avoiding heavy food **while** recovering from food poisoning.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar ovqatdan zaharlanishdan **tiklanayotganda** og'ir taomdan saqlanishni maslahat beradi.

sentences.text: **For** the last ten years, Tashkent has been growing faster than ever.
sentences.translation: So'nggi o'n yil **davomida** Toshkent har qachongidan tez o'sib bormoqda.

sentences.text: Some students work part-time **during** term, but most only work **during** the holidays.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi talabalar o'qish **davomida** yarim stavkada ishlaydi, lekin ko'pchiligi faqat ta'til **paytida** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Would you mind looking after my bag **while** I go and buy a ticket?
sentences.translation: Men chipta olib **kelgunimcha** sumkamga qarab tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: James was offered three jobs **while** he was still at university.
sentences.translation: Hali universitetda **o'qib yurgan paytida** Jeymsga uchta ish taklif qilindi.
